title: Exterior part document
description: An exterior part (server/parts/<id>.json): the shared, cross-hull half of a loadout. A part hangs on a hull mount point of matching kind and sufficient size, contributes its mass and its capability tags, and — for engines — carries the thrust and torque that used to be global constants in ship.gleam (docs/modules.md). Derived from the Gleam decoder in server/src/dh_server/part.gleam (part_decoder) — that decoder is the source of truth; this schema is documentation and a typo-catcher, not a substitute for it. additionalProperties is false even though the decoder itself ignores unknown fields, precisely so this schema can catch typos the decoder would silently swallow.

id.description: Unique within server/parts (a duplicate id is a load error, not a last-one-wins).

kind.description: What sort of mount takes it — "engine" for now. Must equal the mount's kind or the fit is refused with mount_wrong_kind. Free-form in the decoder, so left open here.

size.description: The ordered scale: a mount takes any part of its kind whose rank is at most the mount's. Anything else is the content error part_bad_size (server/src/dh_server/part.gleam size_rank, checked by part.decode after the field itself decodes as a plain string).

mass.description: Optional field (decode.optional_field, default 0.0). Added to the hull's dry mass and every fitted module and part; the fit's flight numbers are pooled engine thrust/torque over that total. Either JSON spelling decodes: 4 and 4.0 are the same number (hull.number_decoder).

thrust.description: Optional field (decode.optional_field, default 0.0). Force along the heading; 0 for a non-engine part. Pooled across mounted parts and divided by the fit's total mass to give acceleration. Either JSON spelling decodes: 4 and 4.0 are the same number (hull.number_decoder).

torque.description: Optional field (decode.optional_field, default 0.0). Turning authority; pooled and divided by the fit's total mass to give degrees/s. Either JSON spelling decodes: 4 and 4.0 are the same number (hull.number_decoder).

sprite.description: Optional field (decode.optional_field, default None). The client's key for layering the part onto the hull at its mount; the layering itself lands in M4 iteration 2, and until then the client draws the whole-hull bake.

tags.description: Optional field (decode.optional_field, default {}). A {tag: amount} object. Tags are open strings the engine only compares and sums (server/src/dh_server/hull.gleam tags_decoder); legality is sum(provides) >= sum(requires) pooled across the whole loadout.
